The Gators, led by second year head coach [[Mike White (basketball)|Mike White]], competed in the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) and played their home games at the [[O'Connell Center|Exactech Arena at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]] campus. They finished the season 27–9, 14–4 in SEC play to finish in second place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2016–17 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]], 72–62 in overtime. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 East Tennessee State Buccaneers basketball team|East Tennessee State]], 80–65, in the first round, [[2016–17 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]], 65–39, in the second round, and [[2016–17 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]], 84–83 in overtime on a [[buzzer beater]] in the Sweet Sixteen before losing to fellow SEC member [[2016–17 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]], 77–70, in the Elite Eight, denying their first Final Four appearance since 2014. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Gators]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 21–15, 9–9 in [[2015–16 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for eighth place. They lost to [[2015–16 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they defeated [[2015–16 North Florida Ospreys men's basketball team|North Florida]] and [[2015–16 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|George Washington]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
